SELECT TEMP.ORG_CODE as ORGCODE, ifnull(INFO.FPROD_ID,INFO.PROD_ID) as PRODID, TEMP.OPEN_START as OPENSTART, TEMP.OPEN_VDATE as OPENEND, INFO.PRD_VDATE as VDATE, INFO.OPERATE_MODE as OPERATEMODE, TEMP.STATUS, code.REG_CODE REGCODE FROM (
SELECT DEAL.ORG_CODE, DEAL.PROD_ID, DEAL.FPROD_ID, ifnull(OPEN1.OPEN_START,(case DEAL.TRADE_TYPE when '04' then DEAL.INTEREST_DATE else DEAL.SETTDATE_DATE end)) OPEN_START, ifnull(OPEN1.OPEN_END,(case DEAL.TRADE_TYPE when '04' then DEAL.INTEREST_DATE else DEAL.SETTDATE_DATE end)) OPEN_END, CASE WHEN #{openProdMdateConf,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '02' AND DEAL.TRADE_TYPE IN ('02', '03', '17') THEN ifnull(OPEN1.OPEN_END, ifnull(OPEN1.OPEN_VDATE,DEAL.SETTDATE_DATE)) ELSE ifnull(OPEN1.OPEN_VDATE,(case DEAL.TRADE_TYPE when '04' then DEAL.INTEREST_DATE else DEAL.SETTDATE_DATE end)) END OPEN_VDATE, case when DATE_FORMAT(DEAL.UPDATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d') != DATE_FORMAT(DEAL.SETTDATE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') and DEAL.Status='E' then 'M' else DEAL.Status end Status FROM CHB_PRD_DEAL DEAL LEFT JOIN CHB_PRD_OPENSCH OPEN1 ON ifnull(DEAL.FPROD_ID,DEAL.PROD_ID) = OPEN1.PROD_ID
AND (case DEAL.TRADE_TYPE when '04' then DEAL.INTEREST_DATE else DEAL.SETTDATE_DATE end) = OPEN1.OPEN_VDATE AND OPEN1.STATUS != 'D' AND OPEN1.PLAN_TYPE = '01' WHERE (DATE_FORMAT(DEAL.UPDATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{batchDate,jdbcType = VARCHAR} or DATE_FORMAT((case DEAL.TRADE_TYPE when '04' then DEAL.INTEREST_DATE else DEAL.SETTDATE_DATE end), '%Y-%m-%d') = #{batchDate,jdbcType = VARCHAR}) AND DEAL.TRADE_TYPE != '01'
AND ifnull(DEAL.FPROD_ID,DEAL.PROD_ID) in
#{accountid}
UNION ALL
SELECT YIELD.ORG_CODE, YIELD.PROD_ID, YIELD.FPROD_ID, ifnull(OPEN1.OPEN_START,YIELD.CHANGE_DATE) OPEN_START, ifnull(OPEN1.OPEN_END,YIELD.CHANGE_DATE) OPEN_END, ifnull(OPEN1.OPEN_VDATE,YIELD.CHANGE_DATE) OPEN_VDATE, case when DATE_FORMAT(YIELD.UPDATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d') != DATE_FORMAT(YIELD.CHANGE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') and YIELD.status='E' then 'M' else YIELD.status end status FROM CHB_PRD_PERIODYIELD YIELD LEFT JOIN CHB_PRD_OPENSCH OPEN1 ON ifnull(YIELD.FPROD_ID,YIELD.PROD_ID) = OPEN1.PROD_ID
AND YIELD.CHANGE_DATE = OPEN1.OPEN_VDATE AND OPEN1.STATUS != 'D' AND OPEN1.PLAN_TYPE = '01' WHERE (DATE_FORMAT(YIELD.UPDATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{batchDate,jdbcType = VARCHAR} or DATE_FORMAT(YIELD.CHANGE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{batchDate,jdbcType = VARCHAR})
AND ifnull(YIELD.FPROD_ID,YIELD.PROD_ID) in
#{accountid}
/*起息日当天的不报送*/ AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CHB_PRD_BASEINFO INFO WHERE INFO.VDATE = YIELD.CHANGE_DATE and ifnull(YIELD.FPROD_ID,YIELD.PROD_ID) = info.prod_id) UNION ALL
SELECT FEEINFO.ORG_CODE, FEEINFO.PROD_ID, FEEINFO.FPROD_ID, ifnull(OPEN1.OPEN_START,FEEINFO.PAY_DATE) OPEN_START, ifnull(OPEN1.OPEN_END,FEEINFO.PAY_DATE) OPEN_END, ifnull(OPEN1.OPEN_VDATE,FEEINFO.PAY_DATE) OPEN_VDATE, case when DATE_FORMAT(FEEINFO.UPDATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d') != DATE_FORMAT(FEEINFO.PAY_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') and FEEINFO.status='E' then 'M' else FEEINFO.status end status FROM CHB_PRD_FEE_DEAL FEEINFO LEFT JOIN CHB_PRD_OPENSCH OPEN1 ON ifnull(FEEINFO.FPROD_ID,FEEINFO.PROD_ID) = OPEN1.PROD_ID
AND FEEINFO.PAY_DATE = OPEN1.OPEN_VDATE AND OPEN1.STATUS != 'D' AND OPEN1.PLAN_TYPE = '01' WHERE (DATE_FORMAT(FEEINFO.UPDATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{batchDate,jdbcType = VARCHAR} or DATE_FORMAT(FEEINFO.PAY_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{batchDate,jdbcType = VARCHAR})
AND FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE = '01'
AND ifnull(FEEINFO.FPROD_ID,FEEINFO.PROD_ID) in
#{accountid}
) TEMP INNER JOIN CHB_PRD_BASEINFO INFO ON INFO.PROD_ID = ifnull(TEMP.FPROD_ID,TEMP.PROD_ID)
AND INFO.STATUS != 'D' AND INFO.OPERATE_MODE IN ('03', '04') left join CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE code on code.prodid=ifnull(TEMP.FPROD_ID,TEMP.PROD_ID) GROUP BY TEMP.ORG_CODE, ifnull(INFO.FPROD_ID,INFO.PROD_ID), TEMP.OPEN_START, TEMP.OPEN_VDATE, INFO.PRD_VDATE, INFO.OPERATE_MODE, TEMP.status, code.REG_CODE
